title: Exit labels for shift operations
statement: For each shift-operation site, assign its continuation label as follows: shifting the setup value continues at the outer search label; pushing continues at phase $0$ of the corresponding saved-endpoint move; and popping continues at phase $0$ of the corresponding subtraction operation. The label type is parameterized by a natural number $E$.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a shift-operation site
The label type is parameterized by a natural number $E$
